system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

Using the secret techniques of the Vesper clan, you are able to wrestle control of the Shadows upon the battlefield, and twist them into aspects of fear and extensions of yourself.

When you complete a rest, you may select two of the listed abilities, being able to utilize them until you complete your next rest. These abilities use your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus, if they require an attack or saving throw.

Umbral Domain

As an Action, select a point you can see within 60 feet of you. A 30-foot radius zone of shadows manifest for the next minute. Spaces within this zone is treated as Chakra based darkness and difficult terrain. You can see normally in this affected area and its area is not difficult terrain for you. When a hostile creature begins its turn in the affected area, they must make a Wisdom saving throw. This ability counts as a C-Rank Genjutsu, with the Visual and Tactile keywords. Its damage increases by 1d8 at 11th and 15th levels.

Success: Affected creature takes half of 4d8 psychic damage.

Failure: Affected creature takes 4d8 psychic damage and gains 1 rank of Demoralized.

Critical Failure: Affected creature takes 6d8 psychic damage and gains 2 rank of Demoralized.

Dread Weave

Once per turn, when you cast a Genjutsu with the Visual or Auditory keywords, you can layer abject terror into it. A creature that fails their saving throw, gains 1 rank of Shaken. Creatures that critically fail their saving throw gains 1 rank of Shaken and become Berserked.

| #### Umbral Monarch / Battle Amp / You become a shadow wreathed beast of the night. / Nocturnal Wings. You gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed, with wings attached to your arms / Sonar. You always have the benefit of Echolocation, and can use Pinging once per turn, on your turn at no action cost. / Beast Claws. Your [Unarmed Damage], while in your Claws of the Night stance, increases by +2. This increases to +4 at 15th level. / Fearless. If you begin your turn with 1 rank of Demoralized or Shaken, you reduce the ranks of said conditions to 0. / Crimson Feast. Once per turn, when you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a creature with ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage, you can reduce their ranks of said condition to 0. If you do, you regain 1d10 hit points for each rank removed. / Sonic Lance. As an Action, you can fire a 60-foot long, 5-foot-wide beam of destructive sound force. All creatures in the affected area must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 6d6 force damage and are Deafened until the end of their next turn, or half as much damage on a success. / Umbral Shockwave. As an Action, you release a Pulse of darkness centered on you, filling a 20-foot radius. Creatures in range must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. This counts as a Genjutsu, with the Visual, Auditory and Tactile keywords. / Success: Affected creature are Dazzled until the end of their next turn. / Failure: Affected creature are Blinded, until the end of their next turn. / Critical Failure: Same as failure, but are also Confused for the same duration. |

Additionally, if the creature that failed or critically failed their saving throw has 2 or more ranks of Demoralized, increase the ranks of Shaken inflicted by this effect by +1.

Terror-Borne Constructs

When you summon a Creature as a result of a Genjutsu you cast or summon a creature with the Illusory Construct trait, it gains the following benefits, while they remain summoned;

They gain additional Hit points equal to 5 + your level.

The first time they deal damage each turn, increase the damage they deal by +2. This increases to +4 at 11th level.

Mist Step

As a bonus action, while not in direct sunlight, you transform into a swirl of mist and teleport into a space you can see that can hold you, up to 40 feet away. Increase the distance you can teleport in this way by +20 feet at 11th level.

Once you teleport using this feature, you cannot do so again, until you cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu of C-Rank or higher that costs chakra.

Vapor Reprieve

When you take damage, you can spend your reaction to transform a portion of the damaged area into mist softening the impact. When you do, you reduce the damage taken by 2 damage dice. This increases to 3 damage dice at 15th level.

Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again, until you cast a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu of C-Rank or higher that costs chakra.
